claim: For 3-union-free 3-uniform hypergraphs on 10 vertices, \(U_3(10,3)=8\), and every 8-edge extremal family is, up to relabeling, the pair-star consisting of all triples containing one fixed pair.

correctness.rationale: The pair-star lower bound is direct. For the upper bound, the symmetric group reduces the first two edges to three intersection orbits, and the embedded exact search enumerates every feasible continuation while rejecting only hereditary union collisions. All three 9-edge orbit searches are empty. The same exhaustive search rules out every 8-edge family without a common pair; an 8-edge family with a common pair must be the full pair-star. The embedded verifier was replayed successfully from the packaged path. The proof is finite and makes no inference from partial enumeration or timeout.
